en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziiyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abu Jameela, from Zayd Al Shahaam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘She can be returned, the woman with vitiligo, and the insanity, and the leprosy’. I said, ‘The blind?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from abu Jamilah from Zayd al-Shahham who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Marriage of a woman with illness of al-Bars (albino), insanity and leprosy is revoked and invalid.’ I asked about a blind. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, it does not apply to her.’”
